subject: 英语
source: 人教版(PEP)小学英语（三年级起点，3-6年级）语法与功能句型体系
original_text: 交通方式：by bus, by bike, by subway, on foot。句型：How do you come to school? — I come on foot. / I come by bus. 爱好：What's your hobby? — I like reading stories. 动词 like 后接动名词（-ing）作宾语。
formulas: 示例：I come to school by bike. / My hobby is dancing.
cautions: ①by 后接交通工具无冠词（by bus 非 by a bus）；②步行用 on foot（不用 by foot）；③like 后接 -ing（reading 非 read）；④hobby 复数是 hobbies（辅音+y 变 i+es）。
